problem: Organisations are increasingly adopting AI-powered chatbots to help employees access HR information relating to leave policies, payroll, employee benefits, insurance, reimbursements, onboarding and other HR processes. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enables intelligent, context-aware responses, but the cost of operating these solutions becomes significant as employee adoption and query volumes grow. Design and develop a cost-efficient, scalable AI-powered HR Assistant that can handle a multi-step employee conversation at a very minimal targeted cost — including all associated costs such as LLM inference, embedding generation, vector database operations, document retrieval, reranking, context processing and an appropriate allocation of knowledge-base ingestion and infrastructure costs. For the college-level scope, first develop a reimbursement system with assumed policies: multi-turn conversation, context storing and RAG are mandatory, and cost optimization with accuracy is the KPI.
audience: Enterprise AI and HR platform teams; developers building RAG assistants over policy documents; teams that must measure and reduce the operating cost of LLM applications.
outcome: A working prototype HR assistant for the reimbursement scenario with measurable cost savings against an unoptimised baseline, and a transparent, end-to-end cost breakdown.

required.title: RAG over assumed HR policies
required.text: Retrieve answers from your documented reimbursement policies using embeddings, a vector store, retrieval and reranking. RAG is mandatory — a prompt-only LLM without retrieval does not satisfy the brief.

required.title: Reimbursement system first
required.text: Build the reimbursement scenario with assumed policies as the demonstration domain, covering eligibility, limits, process steps and employee queries.

required.title: Multi-turn conversation
required.text: Handle multi-step employee conversations with context storing across turns — follow-ups, clarifying questions and continued threads must work.

required.title: Full cost accounting
required.text: Instrument every stage: LLM inference, embedding generation, vector database operations, document retrieval, reranking and context processing, plus an allocation of knowledge-base ingestion and infrastructure costs.

required.title: Cost optimization
required.text: Explore intelligent model selection, semantic caching, optimised retrieval, token consumption reduction and efficient infrastructure utilisation.

required.title: Quality maintained
required.text: Maintain high response accuracy, reliability, data security and employee experience while cutting cost — savings that degrade quality do not count.

optional.title: Broader HR coverage
optional.text: Extend beyond reimbursement to leave, payroll, benefits or onboarding once the core system works.

optional.title: Live cost dashboard
optional.text: Show per-query cost accumulating in real time as conversations run.

optional.title: Security guardrails
optional.text: Data-security and privacy controls for sensitive employee information in the knowledge base.

workflow: Document the assumed reimbursement policies → build the RAG assistant with multi-turn conversation and context storing → instrument per-stage costs → measure an unoptimised baseline → apply model selection, semantic caching, retrieval and token optimizations → verify accuracy holds → report measurable savings and the end-to-end cost breakdown.

deliverables.title: Working prototype
deliverables.text: The reimbursement HR assistant demonstrated end to end with multi-turn RAG conversations.

deliverables.title: Transparent cost breakdown
deliverables.text: A per-query, end-to-end cost breakdown covering inference, embeddings, vector database, retrieval, reranking, context processing, ingestion and infrastructure allocations.

deliverables.title: Cost savings evidence
deliverables.text: Measured savings per conversation against the unoptimised baseline RAG stack.

deliverables.title: Optimization writeup
deliverables.text: The techniques applied — model selection, caching, retrieval tuning, token reduction — and the measured impact of each.

deliverables.title: Quality report
deliverables.text: Response accuracy, reliability and employee-experience checks showing quality held while cost dropped.

success.title: Working RAG assistant — gate
success.text: Multi-turn conversation, context storing and RAG all function on the reimbursement scenario.

success.title: Cost efficiency — primary KPI
success.text: Measurable, reproducible cost savings per conversation against the baseline.

success.title: Response accuracy
success.text: Answers stay accurate and grounded in the assumed policies while costs drop.

success.title: Scalability
success.text: The design handles increasing employee adoption and query volumes at controlled cost.

success.title: Transparency
success.text: A clear, honest, end-to-end cost breakdown accompanies the demo.

constraints.title: RAG mandatory
constraints.text: Multi-turn conversation, context storing and RAG are must-haves; the KPI is cost optimization with accuracy.

constraints.title: Assumed policies
constraints.text: College teams write the reimbursement policies themselves; they must be documented, consistent and supplied with the submission.

constraints.title: All-in cost model
constraints.text: The cost accounting must include LLM inference, embeddings, vector database operations, retrieval, reranking, context processing, knowledge-base ingestion and infrastructure allocations — not just the LLM API bill.

constraints.title: No quality trade-off
constraints.text: Cost cuts that degrade response accuracy, reliability, data security or employee experience are not valid savings.

scope.title: In scope
scope.text: A cost-efficient RAG-based HR assistant prototype for the reimbursement scenario, with multi-turn conversation, context storing, per-stage cost accounting and optimization.

scope.title: Out of scope
scope.text: Integration with production HR or payroll systems and live employee data; training custom foundation models.

scope.title: KPI note
scope.text: Cost optimization with accuracy is the KPI — every claimed saving must be reported alongside the accuracy it preserves.

resources.title: RAG reference architectures
resources.text: Retrieval, reranking and context-processing pipeline patterns to model the baseline and the optimised stack.

resources.title: LLM pricing documentation
resources.text: Token and model pricing for hosted and local models to build the cost model.

resources.title: Vector database options
resources.text: Vector stores and embedding services with their operational cost profiles.

resources.title: Galent team
